audit.whatIsWrong: Favoured matchup, Vel'Koz winning every stage, matches the packet's chart and both layers agree.
audit.why: Yuumi has no CC unattached and true damage ignores her heal-based sustain answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named an ability 'Tectonic Disruption' (Malphite's ult) and had no digit.
audit.why: Yuumi's real numbers: You and Me! (W) has no cooldown, Zoomies (E) is 10s, Final Chapter (R) is 120/110/100s and is a stationary channel.
audit.corrected: You and Me! (W) has no cooldown — she can re-attach instantly, so kill the host or catch her mid-dismount. Zoomies (E) is 10s and passes its shield to her ally when attached. Final Chapter (R) is 120/110/100s — a stationary channel for both of you if she stays attached, so ult it.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Prowling Projectile (Q) deals bonus damage only after 1.35s travel, and Final Chapter (R) heals through sustained damage while channeling — both are Yuumi-specific facts the bleed text never states.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d -> the Q wind-up punish; dontsFull[2].d -> burst before the R channel, not during.
